mapper.select: select a.*,t.allowupdate,t.allowformula, row_number() over (order by t.showorder,a.bblc) rn from (SELECT * FROM tjbb_line_item t WHERE t.qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}) t , ${fname} a where t.bblc(+)=a.bblc and a.swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and a.ssny=#{ssny}

select a.*,t.allowupdate,t.allowformula, row_number() over (order by a.swjgdm,a.bblc) rn from (SELECT * FROM tjbb_line_item t WHERE t.qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}) t , ${fname} a where t.bblc(+)=a.bblc and a.ssny=#{ssny} and exists (select 1 from tjbb_task where bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and ny=#{ssny} and ( ( sjswjg=#{swjgdm} and substr(swjgdm,1,5)=substr(a.swjgdm,1,5)) or (swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and swjgdm=a.swjgdm) ) )

select a.*,t.allowupdate,t.allowformula, row_number() over (order by a.swjgdm) rn from (SELECT * FROM tjbb_line_item t WHERE t.qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}) t ,tjbb_task k, ${fname} a where t.bblc(+)=a.bblc and k.sjswjg=#{swjgdm} and k.bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and a.swjgdm=k.swjgdm and k.ny=a.ssny and a.swjgdm like #{preSwjgdm}||'%' and a.ssny=#{ssny}

select a.*,t.allowupdate,t.allowformula, row_number() over (order by t.showorder,a.bblc) rn from (SELECT * FROM tjbb_line_item t WHERE t.qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}) t , ${fname} a where t.bblc(+)=a.bblc and (a.swjgdm = #{swjgdm} or ( a.swjgdm in (select swjg_dm from table(Func_Get_Xj_swjg(#{swjgdm}))) )) and a.ssny=#{ssny} order by a.swjgdm,a.bblc
select * from tjbb_report_header where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type=2 and bh in (select max(bh) from tjbb_report_header t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type=2 group by horder ) order by horder
select * from tjbb_report_header where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type=1 and horder in (select max(horder) from tjbb_report_header t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and type=1 )
select fname from tjbb_header_cols t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and xlscol=#{colsNum}
select t.bbdlmc,a.*,a.status as statusDm from tjbb_report_item t,tjbb_task a where a.bbdldm=t.bbdldm and a.swjgdm=#{swjgDm} and a.ny= #{ssny} order by t.bbdldm

select a.bbmc, decode(hztime, null, 0, 1) ishz, decode(xgtime, null, 0, 1) isxg, t.* from tjbb_task_sub t, tjbb_report_list a where t.bbdm = a.bbdm and swjgdm = #{swjgdm} and ny = #{ssny} and t.bbdldm = #{bbdldm} order by a.showorder
select t.bbdldm, c.bbdm, c.bbmc,t.bbdlmc from tjbb_report_item t, tjbb_report_list c where t.bbdldm = c.bbdldm and t.type='1' order by bbdldm, bbdm
mapper.update: create table ${tablename} ( PARAMHASH VARCHAR2(64) not null, BBLC VARCHAR2(10) not null, SWJGDM VARCHAR2(32) not null, CRTIME DATE default sysdate )
alter table ${tablename} add constraint ${pkname} primary key (SSNY, BBLC, SWJGDM)
alter table ${tablename} add constraint ${pkname} primary key (PARAMHASH, BBLC, SWJGDM)
mapper.insert:
insert into ${tablename}(swjgdm,bblc,ssny,
${fname},
${item},${item}_HZ
) select #{swjgdm},d.bblc,#{ssny},
#{fvalue},
sum(${item}),sum(${item}_HZ)
from tjbb_task t,${tablename} d,tjbb_line_item e where t.swjgdm in (select swjg_dm from table(Func_Get_Xj_swjg(#{swjgdm}))) and t.bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and d.swjgdm=t.swjgdm and t.ny=d.ssny and d.ssny=#{ssny} and e.bblc=d.bblc and e.hztype='1' and e.bbdm=#{bbdm} group by d.bblc

insert into ${tablename}(swjgdm,bblc,ssny,
${fname},
${item},${item}_HZ
) select #{swjgdm},bblc,#{ssny},
#{fvalue},
sum(${item}),sum(${item}_HZ)
from tjbb_task t,${tablename} d where t.swjgdm in (select swjg_dm from table(Func_Get_Xj_swjg(#{swjgdm}))) and t.bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and d.swjgdm=t.swjgdm and t.ny=d.ssny and ssny=#{ssny} group by bblc
mapper.delete:
delete from ${tablename} where swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and ssny=#{ssny}
and bblc=#{bblc}
delete from tjbb_task_sub where swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and ny=#{ssny} and bbdldm=#{bbdldm}
mapper.select: select fname,cname,xlscol as bh from tjbb_header_cols t where bbdm=#{bbdm} and showorder is not null and t.note <> 'OWN' order by showorder
select t.bblc as fname,t.lcmc as cname,xlsrow as bh from tjbb_line_item t where t.bbdm =#{bbdm}
select count(*) from ${tablename}
select count(*) from tjbb_header_cols t where bbdm=#{bbdm}

select t1.column_name as fname, t1.data_type as ftype, nvl(t1.data_precision,t1.data_length) as maxlen,t1.data_scale as degree, t2.comments from user_tab_columns t1 inner join user_col_comments t2 on t1.table_name||t1.column_name=t2.table_name||t2.column_name where t1.table_name = upper(#{tablename}) order by column_id
select bblc as tblc, hzobj as bblc from tjbb_line_item t where hztype='2' and hzobj is not null and qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}
select fname as tblc, hzobj as bblc from tjbb_header_cols t where hztype='2' and hzobj is not null and qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}
select fname as zbcol, hzobj as bblc from tjbb_header_cols t where hztype='3' and hzobj is not null and qybj='Y' and bbdm=#{bbdm}

select trim(replace(replace(substr(t.formula,1,instr(t.formula,'=')-1),'(',''),')','')) as zbcol, replace( replace( replace( replace(replace( replace(substr(t.formula,instr(t.formula,'=')+1,length(t.formula)),'*100',''),'(',''),')+',','),')/',',') ,')-',',') ,')','') as bblc, substr(t.formula,instr(t.formula,'=')+1,length(t.formula)) as formula from tjbb_report_formula t where type=1 and t.bbdm=#{bbdm} and ishzjs='1' order by yxj

select trim(to_char(replace(replace(substr(t.formula,1,instr(t.formula,'=')-1),'(',''),')',''),'00')) as bblc, replace( replace( replace( replace(replace( replace(substr(t.formula,instr(t.formula,'=')+1,length(t.formula)),'*100',''),'(',''),')+',','),')/',',') ,')-',',') ,')','') as bblcstr, substr(t.formula,instr(t.formula,'=')+1,length(t.formula)) as formula from tjbb_report_formula t where type=2 and t.bbdm=#{bbdm} and t.ishzjs='1' order by yxj
select ${col} from ${tablename} where ssny=#{ssny} and swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and bblc=#{bblc}
select ${col}_HZ from ${tablename} where ssny=#{ssny} and swjgdm=#{swjgdm} and bblc=#{bblc}

select bbdm,t.excelcol as startCol,t.excelrow as startRow, t.headcol as headCol,t.headrow as headRow,t.endrow as endRow from tjbb_report_list t where bbdldm=#{bbdldm} and qybj='Y' order by t.showorder

select rwlx,rwhash,rwbw as tjtj,swjg.swjg_jc as swjg,czrymc as tjr,frtime as tjrq,bz from tl_admin.rwgl_ybcl_xxzb xxzb left outer join tl_admin.dm_swjg swjg on (xxzb.swjgdm = swjg.swjg_dm) where swjgdm like #{swjg} ||'%'
and rwbw like '%' || #{tjlx} || '%'
and ((czrymc like '%' || #{tjr} || '%') or (czrydm like '%' || #{tjr} || '%'))
and to_char(frtime,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{tjrq}
order by frtime desc
select a.swjg_dm as swjgdm,b.dispsx,b.swjg_jc as swjgjc from table(func_get_xj_swjg(#{swjgDm})) a ,dm_swjg b where a.swjg_dm=b.swjg_dm order by a.swjg_dm
mapper.delete: delete from rwgl_ybcl_xxzb where rwlx = #{rwlx} and rwhash = #{rwhash}
